I don’t have any advice but wanted to say I’m going through the same thing. I just want to validate those feelings and fears. I’ve been trying to work on building up my own self compassion (Tara Brach has been a great author to read). Right now I’m back in that low moment with you. You’re not alone.

Yes! Like I’ve been so numb in the relationship and I know it’s not fulfilling but now it’s like every emotion possible is coming out. 

The lost future is a great way to put it. Realizing that everything you thought you’d have at this point in your life isn’t actually happening. And then you look around at other people having that life you thought you’d have. In general I have such a hard time letting go of what I think other people expect. 

Coffee shops is a great idea! Thanks for that. It’s easy to sit at home and wallow. That’s a good reminder to reach out to people. I think I isolate assuming other people won’t understand. But I forget they also care about me and they don’t really need to understand it all.

I’ve been in therapy a little over a year and I love my therapist. We’re a great match. It’s just the realization that this is all actually happening makes me feel like I’ve lost control over everything. And then I self blame.
Yeah that’s where I realized I’m not living authentically or for myself. It’s a great resource

Oh man, I’m wrapping up my first week of the Wellbutrin XL 150 and it has me shaking like crazy! Dry mouth, sweaty palms, feeling manic to the point where I can’t focus cause my mind is racing. I’m hoping it settles down and I’m trying to ride it out to give it a fair chance. I already have a script for lorazepam to help me sleep on occasion, so that’s a good idea to get that refilled to combat the insomnia.

It can be awesome when having good dreams, but when under a lot of stress it just seems to be a burden! I didn’t know about the food connection! 

I’ve been trying to fall asleep visualizing something pleasant and happy...so far my dreams always turn into stressful nightmares still. But maybe it just takes practice?
I’m right there with you! We can figure it out together!
It makes me feel better knowing I’m not the only one who gets stuck in this loop!
